tagline.en: Mexico to Canada down the length of the West Coast
tagline.zh: 自墨西哥至加拿大，纵贯整个西海岸

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.en: San Ysidro Port of Entry at the Mexican border, San Diego, California
start.zh: 加利福尼亚州圣迭戈，墨西哥边境圣伊西德罗口岸

end.en: Peace Arch border crossing, Blaine, Washington
end.zh: 华盛顿州布莱恩，和平门边境口岸

en: I-5 is the only Interstate that runs border to border on the Pacific side of the country, from a Customs plaza at San Ysidro to the Peace Arch at Blaine. It serves San Diego, Los Angeles, Sacramento, Portland and Seattle, and it is the sole continuous freeway spine for the entire West Coast — there is no parallel Interstate to fall back on.

Between cities it is remarkably empty. The long middle of the California section, the Westside Freeway, was deliberately routed away from the San Joaquin Valley's towns: it runs dead straight along the dry west side of the valley past feedlots and almond orchards, with the older highway through Fresno and Bakersfield left as State Route 99. North of the Tehachapis it climbs the Grapevine, and in northern California and southern Oregon it becomes a mountain road over the Siskiyous.

The Pacific Northwest section is different again. From Portland to the Canadian border I-5 threads a narrow corridor between the Cascades and Puget Sound, and it is here — through Tacoma, Seattle and Everett — that the road carries its heaviest and most constrained traffic.
zh: I-5 是全国太平洋一侧唯一从边境通到边境的州际公路，南起圣伊西德罗的海关广场，北至布莱恩的和平门。它服务圣迭戈、洛杉矶、萨克拉门托、波特兰和西雅图，是整个西海岸唯一一条连续的高速公路主干——没有平行的州际公路可以替代。
城市之间的路段却相当空旷。加州段中部漫长的西侧高速公路刻意绕开了圣华金河谷的城镇：它沿着河谷干燥的西侧笔直穿行，两旁是饲养场和杏仁园，而经过弗雷斯诺和贝克斯菲尔德的旧干线则保留为 SR 99。翻过特哈查比山脉后，它攀上「葡萄藤」坡道；到了北加州与南俄勒冈，它又变成翻越西斯基尤山的山区公路。
太平洋西北段又是另一副面貌。从波特兰到加拿大边境，I-5 穿行于喀斯喀特山脉与普吉特海湾之间的狭窄走廊；正是在这里——经过塔科马、西雅图和埃弗里特——这条路承担着最繁重、也最受地形约束的交通。

en: The corridor was approved as part of the national system in 1947, a decade before the Interstate programme began, and the number was applied in the 1957 numbering — after a brief interlude in which California proposed calling it I-11.

Most of the route was built by upgrading or replacing existing US highways, chiefly US 99. The exception was the Westside Freeway, the new-build bypass of the San Joaquin Valley's cities, which was approved in 1957 and took three phases and more than a decade to construct: to Los Banos by 1967, south to Wheeler Ridge and SR 99 by 1972, and finally north to Sacramento.

The last segment was dedicated near Stockton on 12 October 1979. Representatives from both Canada and Mexico attended, because what opened that day was the first Interstate running without interruption from one international border to the other.
zh: 这条走廊早在 1947 年就被列入国家干线系统，比州际公路计划的启动早了十年；编号则在 1957 年的编号工作中确定——期间加州还短暂提议将其命名为 I-11。
路线的大部分是通过改建或取代既有的联邦公路（主要是 US 99）而成。例外是西侧高速公路——绕开圣华金河谷各城市的新建线位，1957 年获批，分三期施工，历时十余年：1967 年通到洛斯巴诺斯，1972 年南接惠勒岭与 SR 99，最后向北延至萨克拉门托。
最后一段于 1979 年 10 月 12 日在斯托克顿附近举行通车仪式。加拿大和墨西哥双方均派代表出席，因为那天通车的是第一条从一国边境不间断通往另一国边境的州际公路。

en: On 23 May 2013 an over-height truck load clipped the overhead steel truss of the Skagit River Bridge at Mount Vernon, and a 160-foot span dropped into the river with two vehicles on it. Three people were rescued; nobody was killed. Because I-5 has no parallel Interstate in Washington, the failure of one span severed the main road link between Seattle and Vancouver.

Washington State DOT put a temporary military-style span in place within a month and ran a compressed design-build competition for the permanent replacement, with liquidated damages written into the bids at $660,000 for every day I-5 stayed closed. The permanent girder span was slid into place during a single overnight closure and the bridge reopened 115 days after the collapse.

The episode is the clearest illustration of what this route's lack of redundancy costs. The bridge was built in 1955, predating the Interstate it carries, and its low overhead clearance over the outside lanes was the direct cause of the strike.
zh: 2013 年 5 月 23 日，一辆超高货车挂到了芒特弗农斯卡吉特河大桥的上部钢桁架，一段 160 英尺长的桥跨连同上面的两辆车一起坠入河中。三人获救，无人死亡。由于 I-5 在华盛顿州没有平行的州际公路，一跨桥梁的失效就切断了西雅图与温哥华之间的主要陆路通道。
华盛顿州交通部在一个月内架起了临时军用式桥跨，并就永久替换方案举行了压缩工期的设计—施工总承包竞标，招标文件中直接写入了违约金条款：I-5 每多关闭一天罚款 66 万美元。永久性梁式桥跨在一次通宵封闭中滑移到位，大桥在垮塌后第 115 天恢复通行。
这起事件最清楚地说明了这条路线缺乏冗余的代价。该桥建于 1955 年，比它所承载的州际公路还早，而外侧车道上方净空过低正是撞击的直接原因。

value.en: $3.993 billion — California $1.913 billion, Washington $1.373 billion, Oregon $706.3 million. State and federal funds combined, in dollars of the day, as tabulated by FHWA at the close of the Interstate Construction programme; it excludes reconstruction after 1989.
value.zh: 39.93 亿美元——加利福尼亚 19.13 亿、华盛顿 13.73 亿、俄勒冈 7.063 亿美元。州与联邦资金合计，按当年美元计，为联邦公路管理局在州际建设计划收尾时的统计口径；不含 1989 年以后的改建。

figures.source: FHWA, Interstate System engineering data, Part III – Cost: estimated cost of individual Interstate routes, 1991 Interstate Cost Estimate (data as of 31 December 1989)

label.zh: 斯卡吉特河大桥永久替换桥跨

value.en: $6.87 million design-build contract; about $8.5 million including removal of the temporary span, paid from federal emergency relief funds
value.zh: 设计—施工总承包合同额 687 万美元；连同拆除临时桥跨约 850 万美元，由联邦紧急救援资金支付

figures.source: Washington State DOT, June 2013; Engineering News-Record, September 2013

label.en: Skagit River crossing at the time of the 2013 collapse
label.zh: 2013 年垮塌时斯卡吉特河跨河段的交通量

why.en: Caltrans, ODOT and WSDOT each publish counts for their own segments, and the spread along this route is extreme — the Los Angeles and Seattle sections carry an order of magnitude more traffic than the Siskiyou Mountain crossing. No agency publishes a combined figure.
why.zh: 加州、俄勒冈与华盛顿三州交通部门各自发布本州路段的交通量，而本路线沿途差距极大——洛杉矶与西雅图路段的车流量比西斯基尤山越岭段高出一个数量级。没有机构发布合并数字。

label.zh: 斯卡吉特河大桥恢复通行所需时间

value.en: 115 days from collapse to reopening, and 88 days from the contractor's notice to proceed; the final span swap took a single 19-hour closure
value.zh: 从垮塌到恢复通行共 115 天，自承包商接到开工通知起 88 天；最后的桥跨置换仅封闭 19 小时

timeline.en: The corridor is approved as part of the national system of interstate highways.
timeline.zh: 该走廊获批列入国家州际公路系统。

timeline.en: The number I-5 is applied in the first Interstate numbering, and the Westside Freeway relocation is approved.
timeline.zh: 州际公路首次编号确定 I-5 编号，西侧高速公路改线方案同期获批。

timeline.en: The first phase of the Westside Freeway opens, from the San Joaquin County line to Los Banos.
timeline.zh: 西侧高速公路第一期通车，自圣华金县界至洛斯巴诺斯。

timeline.en: The second phase extends the freeway south to Wheeler Ridge, connecting it to SR 99.
timeline.zh: 第二期将高速公路南延至惠勒岭，与 SR 99 相连。

timeline.en: The final segment is dedicated near Stockton on 12 October, completing the first border-to-border Interstate.
timeline.zh: 最后一段于 10 月 12 日在斯托克顿附近举行通车仪式，第一条跨境贯通的州际公路建成。

timeline.en: A truck strike collapses a span of the Skagit River Bridge; the permanent replacement opens 115 days later.
timeline.zh: 货车撞击导致斯卡吉特河大桥一跨垮塌，永久替换桥跨在 115 天后通车。
